name: Bagoas
description: Eunuch who had charge over all that Holofernes had; at his lord's bidding persuaded Judith to come to the feast; shut Holofernes' tent and dismissed the attendants on the night Judith killed him; the next day found Holofernes dead and headless, and ran out to raise the alarm among the Assyrians

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
